sense.text:
This is in the time of Belshazzar king of Babylon. Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed, and in it he saw four empires. We start with the fourth empire: “a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth.”

To understand what this beast is we go to 2 Esdras, and there it is an eagle. So now we know the fourth beast is an eagle. Ezra says the eagle had three heads and twelve feathers; Daniel explains the great iron teeth and the talons.

“It devoured and brake in pieces”: it devoured and broke in pieces nations. “And stamped the residue with the feet of it”: the residue of the nations they destroyed, they stamped with their philosophies.

“And it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it”: diverse from Babylon, diverse from Persia and Media, diverse from the Greeks. Rome is the name of this beast; it starts off with Rome.

“And it had ten horns”: write this down, the ten horns are the ten common markets. They are the ten common markets today, but it is speaking of the same empire. These empires were alive back then; they just had different names, not the modern names we use now.

“Another little horn”: write this down, the other little horn is the United States of America.

“Before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots.” Write down the three that were plucked up. One, the French: the French American War, from 1754 to 1763. Two, the British: the War of Independence against Britain, 1775 to 1783. Three, the Spanish: the Spanish-American war of 1898. Those nations were all fighting for dominance over this country, so America had to pluck up the French by the roots, get them out of here; pluck up the British, get them out of here; and pluck up the Spanish, get them out of here. Those empires left.

“In this horn were eyes like the eyes of man”: in this country were eyes, great visions. The train, the Industrial Revolution, the automobile, the plane, all the technological advances: everything comes from this place. The Gatling gun too, and the Gatling gun is what they used to kill Gad. Before that, they had to shove the gunpowder in with a stick and could only shoot one shot, pow, then reload, and by that time the arrows were through their neck. So the white man said, Dear Satan, we need a weapon that can kill all these Israelites, and that was the Gatling gun in 1861. That turned the tide.

“And a mouth speaking great things”: we’re going to make trains, we’re going to travel from one side of the world to the other. They made the Suez Canal; the Suez Canal is man-made. We’re going to talk instantaneously, we’re going to have radio and television. All of those things came from the United States of America, not France, not Spain, not Britain. Satan is dealing with this place.

“I beheld till the thrones were cast down”: in this vision Daniel saw all the thrones of the world cast down. Not yet; he already saw the three plucked up. But he saw America destroyed, Germany destroyed, Russia destroyed, Japan destroyed, Saudi Arabia destroyed: all the thrones of the world cast down.

“And the Ancient of days did sit”: the Ancient of days is the Most High, having no beginning of days and no end of days, older than days. “Whose garment was white as snow”: to have a garment you have to have a body, so God has a body. And this white garment was bad; it wasn’t a sheet and it wasn’t a Greek toga. I always imagine that garment changes every few seconds; he’s too bad to have the same garment on for too long.

“And the hair of his head like the pure wool”: so what is God? A black man. And his hair is too bad just to sit in an afro; I imagine braid techniques and everything. And he doesn’t sit corny on the throne; he’s got style: legs wide open, arm cocked to the side. Everything is bad with him.

“His throne was like the fiery flame”: fire all around his throne, magnificent. “And his wheels as burning fire”: he has chariots all around his throne. You’re not just walking up to him saying, let me talk to you a minute. You’ve got to get through thermonuclear destruction first, and you ain’t getting through that. That’s what Daniel is saying.

“A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him”: you can’t just approach the throne. Remember King Ahasuerus with Esther: if he didn’t summon you, by the time you got to him you were put to death. The Most High says, I’ve got fire to take care of that. You don’t just roll up on him; you’re dead.

“Thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him”: those are angels. And the angels have style too; their garments are bad.

“The judgment was set, and the books were opened”: books, with an s, were opened.

“I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake”: because of the voice of the great words which America spake, blasphemous words.

“I beheld even till the beast was slain”: till America was slain, destroyed, “and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.”

precepts.why:
“This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel.” Notice it gives the animal symbol: the eagle. So the fourth beast of Daniel 7 is an eagle.

“But it was not expounded unto him”: it was not explained to Daniel. “Therefore now I declare it unto thee”: so the angel begins to explain this fourth kingdom to Ezra. When you read Ezra, this eagle has three heads and twelve feathers, and Daniel gives the great iron teeth and the talons. Same beast.

Here’s the precept for the beast given to the burning flame. You think America is going to go on forever? No she ain’t. Your hopes and dreams are here, and your hopes and dreams are going to be crushed when America is gone. Remember Lot’s wife.

“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.” That is what is coming to America: she shall be utterly burned with fire.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”: the kings of the earth that did business with her and got rich with America, “shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning.” They are going to cry. This place is not lasting forever, so all your hopes and dreams will go up in dust. Put your hopes and dreams in this Bible, in the Most High God.

sense.text: “The fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others”: different from Babylon, different from Persia and Media, different from Greece. “Exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet”: stamping the residue means they put their philosophies on everyone that was left.

“And of the ten horns that were in his head”: write this down, these are the ten common markets: Greece, France, Luxembourg, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium, Italy, the Netherlands, Germany and Denmark. Today they have a lot more, but these were the first ten.

“And of the other which came up, and before whom three fell”: that is America, and the three that fell before it are the French, the British and the Spanish that they plucked up.

“Even of that horn that had eyes”: America, that had eyes, meaning great visions, inventions. “And a mouth that spake very great things”: evolution is one of their great things, Christianity is another great thing they speak with their mouth: blasphemous things, abominations.

“Whose look was more stout than his fellows”: America’s look is greater than France, than Britain, than Spain, than the so-called United Kingdom and all these European nations. America is the greatest, the most powerful, the most inventive. His fellows are NATO, the EU, his fellow Europeans.

“I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints”: this same horn, America, made war with the Israelites. This is the Birth of a Nation.

“And prevailed against them”: put on the screen is an example of them making war with us, Montezuma in the time of the conquistadors. They destroyed us, they overcame us, they prevailed against us, meaning they enslaved us and colonized us. This is Bible prophecy.

“Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High”: judgment is power, supernatural power to rule this earth. “And the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.” That verse is heavy.

“The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth”: it started with Rome and goes all the way up to America. “And shall devour the whole earth”: America has devoured the whole earth, “and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.”

“The ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise”: you already have the ten common markets. “And another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first”: this is America. The fourth kingdom started with Rome, then came the ten horns, the ten common markets, and then another shall rise after them: that’s America. “And he shall subdue three kings”: the Spanish, the French and Britain. Saying the same thing.

“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: everything he says is going to contradict what the Bible says. We read that God has a woolly head; the white man says no, he has straight, thin, blonde hair. We read the color of the Israelites; he says no, the Jews are white, they’re Caucasian. And the main thing: get rid of God’s laws.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: to wear out the saints means to enslave us. That is how they wore us out in slavery; they brought us down to the level of brute beasts.

He said the new year begins in the dead of winter, and on top of that, that the day begins at midnight. “And laws”: he says marriage is no longer between man and woman; now it’s man and man, woman and woman, and if you want to marry a tree, have at it.

precepts.why:

“And therefore appear no more, thou eagle”: America, appear no more. “Nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers”: the wicked feathers are their Caesars. “Nor thy malicious heads”: America was one, Britain was one, Rome was one. “Nor thy hurtful claws”: the hurtful claws are their military. “Nor all thy vain body”: the vain body is their citizens, their people, man, woman, boy and girl.

It’s saying the same thing, just using a different animal symbol. Daniel and Ezra use the eagle; John the Revelator used the dragon.

Here’s the precept: “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.” Saying the same thing as Daniel.

That is why Christ said, “Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do”. Did Christ walk on water? Yes. Brothers, they are going to be in their bunkers and in the mountains saying, we are safe from the Lamb, and the Lord is going to say, hunters, get them. And the horses are coming decked out with garments. Like Magneto in that movie asking where the president was, waving his hand, there you are, and ripping the doors off the bunker: that’s the hunters of God.

This is the precept for the judgment given to the saints. “And the nations were angry”: because the nations don’t want Christ to return. They lie and say, we want Christ; that’s a lie. The Bible prophesies that when he comes back they are going to be mad.

“The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying, Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus”: the prince of Tyrus is a similitude, a metaphor, a parable. Although that nation did exist at one time, it is making reference today to the United States of America.

sense.text:
Watch what they did with the continent of Africa. Daniel 11 initially goes talking about when the Greeks divided up the land of Israel, which is in Africa, but it goes beyond that.

“Thus shall he do in the most strong holds”: because the white man had the power. “With a strange god”: the strange god that we know today is that white image of Jesus. “Whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”: he increased riches.

“And he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain”: that’s the Berlin Conference, the Scramble for Africa. The Berlin Conference regulated the partitioning of Africa among 14 European countries and the United States; the Scramble for Africa was the period between 1885 and 1910 during which European countries were competing for control of Africa’s territory. For gain: for riches. America didn’t take a piece, but they were behind it all. Look at the nations that took part in it: France, Italy, Britain, Germany, Portugal, Belgium, Spain. This is what the scripture is talking about.

During the Berlin Conference the Portuguese took Zanzibar, next to Tanzania. Look at the slave market in Zanzibar: a photograph, not a drawing, for you ignorant people online, you Christians. This is what your Christians did to us. This is what your loving Christian did. Look at it, pay attention, damn it. You made us your enemy.

“Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word”: that’s you and me, all of us. “Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified”: they cast us out because we love the Lord, and they thought they were doing God’s will.

“But he shall appear to your joy”: Christ shall appear to our joy, “and they shall be ashamed.”
“A voice of noise from the city”: that’s Jerusalem. “A voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies”: the Lord is coming to pay judgment to our enemies.

She is the nation of Israel, our true nation. “Before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child”: this man child is Christ.

You read about the great travail we’re going to go through, but it’s going to be so quick and over that in the Lord’s eyesight it’s going to be like no pain at all. That’s why in some scriptures the Lord said he gave you ‘a little chastisement’.

“Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day?” It means it’s going to grow quickly, the vegetation and all that. “Or shall a nation be born at once?” The growth of the 12 tribes of Israel is going to be so quick it’s like we became a nation in one day.

This is the verse the Christian Broadcast Network used to talk about 1948. This ain’t talking about 1948 with them bastards over there. It’s talking about our people.

“For as soon as Zion travailed”: as soon as the 12 tribes have the childbirth pains, “she brought forth her children.” We’re going to be delivered; we’re going to be established as the 12 tribes of Israel.

“Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth?” We’re coming to the birth now. We’re waking up; the time of our deliverance is at hand. We’re the baby that’s about to be born. Will he not bring us forth? “Shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb?” Will he end us and have us all destroyed? No.

“Rejoice ye with Jerusalem”: we are commanded to rejoice with Jerusalem, “and be glad with her, all ye that love her.” That means love Jerusalem, your homeland. If you love Jamaica, this ain’t for you; if you love Haiti, this ain’t for you either; the same if you love Puerto Rico. This is only for those that love Jerusalem.

“That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations”: the breasts are the Old Covenant and New Covenant, the Old Testament and the New Testament. Consolation is comfort.

“And be delighted with the abundance of her glory”: that’s why we ain’t got time for depression. You depressed? You better shake yourself and wake up; glory is on its way. Being depressed means you don’t believe.

“Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river”: he’s going to extend peace to us, brothers and sisters. “The glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream”: the riches of the Gentiles; we’re going to get rich. “Ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees”: the nations are going to carry our sons and daughters. That’s what it’s talking about.

“As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you”: the Lord is going to comfort the 12 tribes of Israel. “And ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem”: we’re going home, brothers and sisters, we’re going home.

“And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice”: we’re going to rejoice, “and your bones shall flourish like an herb.” “The hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants”: we are the servants of the Lord. “And his indignation toward his enemies”: this is how you know it’s not talking about 1948.

“For, behold, the Lord will come with fire”: more proof it ain’t talking about 1948. This is the chain of events that’s going to happen once we’re delivered and back in our homeland: “his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.”

“For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.” The Messiah, the man child, is going to slay a whole lot of nations. So don’t let a Christian fool you and tell you this is talking about them bastards in 1948. It ain’t talking about that.

precepts.why:

precepts.why: That’s why Obadiah said “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, “whose habitation is high”. It is the same mind that says in her heart, I am, and none else beside me: the pride of America’s heart, dwelling high and careless.

Isaiah 47:11 says desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, and thou shalt not know from whence it riseth. Let’s see what this desolation is going to come from. Many of you have read the book of Obadiah: study it, learn it.

“All the men of thy confederacy”: that’s NATO, that’s their military, and the EU, the European Union, that’s the economic system. “Have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee”: that’s NATO, all the men that were at peace with thee, “have deceived thee”: they have deceived America, “and prevailed against thee”.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast”: that’s what’s going on now. “Until the words of God shall be fulfilled.”

precepts.why:
Go back to Revelation 17 and read verses 4 and 5 together: what’s in the hand of America and what’s in her forehead. “And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand”: in her hand, “full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication”. Now what’s in her forehead: “And upon her forehead”, her mind, “was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” Abominations, straight up sin. sense.text: “And the beast that was, and is not”: the beast in the vision John had, which was not in existence even during the time of John. “Even he is the eighth”: write this, the eighth is America, the United States of America. “And is of the seven”: the seventh head was Britain. “And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” That’s America.

We’re going to be given the earth, world dominion. “Whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom”: our kingdom shall be an everlasting kingdom. “And all dominions shall serve and obey him”: all nations on the planet earth are going to serve and obey Christ.
“Hitherto is the end”: that is God’s plan. That’s his doctrine; that’s what the whole Bible is all about.
